95f74f840b445af8e4790d2e0218cad015db43bb.summary: A code-hosting repository index page titled as documentation of a CCC analysis of the FinSpy state trojan for Android. It lists folders, file names and commit messages only. The report itself is a PDF that is not included in the text, so no threat facts can be recorded.

95a9b62c3535d9bcf354344a050f2df6c1f5644a.summary: AhnLab's ASEC reports that a backdoor previously spread in CHM files is now distributed as malicious LNK shortcut files. The LNKs are disguised as Excel documents, uploaded alongside malware in ZIP and RAR archives on a regular website. When run, the LNK starts PowerShell, sets persistence through a registry Run key, and uses mshta to fetch scripts. The malware polls a server for commands and can collect system, clipboard and file information. The title attributes the activity to RedEyes (ScarCruft). The report says the attacker appears to keep modifying the script code. Published 2023-08-31.
